errors: Duplicate work: the run wrote episode 147 (First Samuel 26, 7,255 words). PR #17572 from another session opened and merged the same episode while this run was writing; the open-PR search at the start had found nothing. The draft was dropped and main's version kept.

doc_friction.issue: 'search open PRs so you do not write the episode another session is already writing' only covers PRs that are already open. Two sessions routed to creative within minutes both took the same next-up list entry (the first sequel left by episode 146), and the second one found no PR because the first had not pushed yet. Claiming the entry in PRODUCTION.md in the first push, before writing, would have shown it, but only if the other session had done the same.

deviations.why: The next sequel after the duplicate was En-gedi (First Samuel 24), but episodes 146 and 147 already tell that scene, in full and in summary. The run took Ziklag (First Samuel 30) instead, the earlier-listed sequel from episode 146.
deviations.did: Pushed a claim on the list line first, then wrote episode 148.
deviations.result: Landed episode 148 with no further collision.

notes: Project: Saints by Candlelight. Piece: episode 148, david-at-ziklag-and-the-egyptian-in-the-field (First Samuel 30), 5,681 words, text only (audio folders at 577 MB, over the 400 MB cap). This replaces a first draft of episode 147, dropped as a duplicate of PR #17572. The adversarial review fixed two things: Nob (the draft said Saul's men killed the priests; per 22:17-18 his guards refused and Doeg did it) and David's protest in 29:8 (the draft called it a show; now left open). Checks: --check-script ok; node --test 18/18; run_workflow_locally --for-changes on the first draft, 11/11 workflows passed; re-run for the final diff is noted in the PR. Lesson for the next run: claim the list line in your first push before writing.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
